description.en: Launch a task through the local OpenCode CLI on the repository's existing dev branch, run the repository checks, and report the result.
description.es: Inicie una tarea a través de la CLI local de OpenCode en la rama dev existente del repositorio, ejecute las comprobaciones del repositorio e informe el resultado.
description.fr: Lancez une tâche via la CLI OpenCode locale sur la branche dev existante du dépôt, exécutez les vérifications du dépôt et signalez le résultat.
description.ro: Lansați o sarcină prin CLI-ul local OpenCode pe branch-ul dev existent al depozitului, rulați verificările depozitului și raportați rezultatul.
description.it: Avvia un'attività tramite la CLI OpenCode locale sul branch dev esistente del repository, esegui i controlli del repository e segnala il risultato.

actions.prompt:
/bash -ls <<'JOAI_SCRIPT'
set -u
CODE_ROOT="${JOAI_CODE_ROOT:-$HOME/Code}"
REPO_NAME=$(cat <<'JOAI_REPO'
{{REPO}}
JOAI_REPO
)
case "$REPO_NAME" in
  ''|.|..|*/*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) echo "OpenCode: invalid repository name: $REPO_NAME" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
REPO_DIR="$CODE_ROOT/$REPO_NAME"
[ -d "$REPO_DIR" ] || { echo "OpenCode: repository not found: $REPO_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$REPO_DIR" || exit 2
git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/dev >/dev/null || { echo "OpenCode: branch 'dev' not found in $REPO_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }

LOCK_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/joai-opencode-${REPO_NAME}.lock"
if ! mkdir "$LOCK_DIR" 2>/dev/null; then
  LOCK_PID=$(cat "$LOCK_DIR/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$LOCK_PID" ] && kill -0 "$LOCK_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "OpenCode: another run is active for $REPO_NAME" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  rm -rf "$LOCK_DIR"
  mkdir "$LOCK_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { echo "OpenCode: could not acquire repository lock" >&2; exit 3; }
fi
echo $$ > "$LOCK_DIR/pid"
trap 'rm -rf "$LOCK_DIR"' EXIT INT TERM

ORIGINAL_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
HEAD_BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git switch dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || git checkout dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "OpenCode: could not switch to branch 'dev' in $REPO_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

TASK_TEXT=$(cat <<'JOAI_TASK_9F2A'
{{TASK}}
JOAI_TASK_9F2A
)
CALLBACK_URL=$(cat <<'JOAI_CALLBACK_URL'
{{CALLBACK_URL}}
JOAI_CALLBACK_URL
)
CALLBACK_TOKEN=$(cat <<'JOAI_CALLBACK_TOKEN'
{{CALLBACK_TOKEN}}
JOAI_CALLBACK_TOKEN
)
RUN_ID_VALUE=$(cat <<'JOAI_RUN_ID'
{{RUN_ID}}
JOAI_RUN_ID
)

OPENCODE_STATUS=0
opencode run --auto "$TASK_TEXT" || OPENCODE_STATUS=$?

CHECK_STATUS=0
CHECKS=none
if [ -f scripts/joai-checks.sh ]; then
  CHECKS=failed
  if bash scripts/joai-checks.sh; then CHECKS=passed; else CHECK_STATUS=1; fi
fi

CHANGED_FILES=$(git status --short)
DIFF_STAT=$(git diff --stat)
BRANCH_AFTER=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
HEAD_AFTER=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
if [ "$BRANCH_AFTER" != "dev" ] || [ "$HEAD_BEFORE" != "$HEAD_AFTER" ]; then
  echo "OpenCode: unexpected commit or branch change (expected branch 'dev', no commits)." >&2
  OPENCODE_STATUS=1
  if [ "$BRANCH_AFTER" = "dev" ] && [ "$HEAD_BEFORE" != "$HEAD_AFTER" ]; then
    git reset --mixed "$HEAD_BEFORE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi

if [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" != "$ORIGINAL_BRANCH" ]; then
  git switch "$ORIGINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "OpenCode: could not restore branch $ORIGINAL_BRANCH" >&2
fi

if [ "$OPENCODE_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ "$CHECK_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then RUN_STATUS=failed; else RUN_STATUS=completed; fi
SUMMARY="OpenCode run on $REPO_NAME (branch dev)
Status: $RUN_STATUS
OpenCode exit: $OPENCODE_STATUS
Checks: $CHECKS
Changed files:
${CHANGED_FILES:-none}
Diff stat:
${DIFF_STAT:-none}"

PAYLOAD=""
if [ -n "$CALLBACK_URL" ] && [ -n "$CALLBACK_TOKEN" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PAYLOAD=$(jq -n --arg itemId "$RUN_ID_VALUE" --arg runStatus "$RUN_STATUS" --arg summary "$SUMMARY" --arg provider "opencode" '{itemId:$itemId,runStatus:$runStatus,summary:$summary,provider:$provider}')
  elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PAYLOAD=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"itemId":sys.argv[1],"runStatus":sys.argv[2],"summary":sys.argv[3],"provider":"opencode"}))' "$RUN_ID_VALUE" "$RUN_STATUS" "$SUMMARY")
  fi
  if [ -n "$PAYLOAD" ]; then
    curl -sS -X POST "$CALLBACK_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CALLBACK_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-JoAi-Request-Id: opencode-$(date +%s)-$$" --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 --data "$PAYLOAD" >/dev/null || true
  fi
fi
printf '%s\n' "$SUMMARY"
[ "$RUN_STATUS" = "completed" ]
JOAI_SCRIPT

description.en: Tracking run ID used by JoAi orchestration.

description.fr: ID d'exécution de suivi utilisé par l'orchestration JoAi.

description.en: Full task instruction to execute with OpenCode CLI.

description.it: Istruzione completa dell'attività da eseguire con la CLI OpenCode.

description.en: Repository directory name under the local code root (for example joai--api).
